messages.text: The Codex SDK is so limited compared to Claude. With Claude, we have hooks, middlewares, system prompts. messages.author: Dennis
messages.text:
[attachment]

How are we currently ordering this multi-organization sidebar view for jobs? I'm thinking that as it enters and leaves each group, it should be a first-in, first-out type of ordering. Obviously, that's impossible to do first in, first out, but what I'm saying is that when a brand-new job gets added from one group to the next, it should be ordered that way. It gets added to the top of the list since it was newly added, and the older ones that have been building for a while will be lower. That way, if we're planning something new, it will be at the top of the list while the old ones are at the bottom.

Once we hit a waiting plan, same thing. The only thing is, when it goes back from a waiting plan back into planning, how do we update the ordering? Obviously, it's going to be time-based, but the question is: when do we update the timing for ordering?
